How to obtain:

1. Register for Epic Pirate Feud during Application Period at Mercenary Mediator (found in all player capital cities by Maritime Guild, or in Pirate towns like Nassau and Jolo)
2. Join Epic Pirate Feud on at least one of the three Feud days and sink at least one NPC fleet
3. Rewards can be collected after the conclusion of the third day's round from Mercenary Mediator

List of drops:

Small Sword Breaker
Bill
Pirate Coat
Great Pirate
Privateer Permit (non-tradable)
Spoils x10
Master Craftsman's Carpentry Tools x10
Master Craftsman's Special Repair Tools x2
Cannonsmith's Forging Tools x2
